snr._definition: SNR = (A (2 pi f)^2 / sqrt 2) / (n_a sqrt B), B = 1 Hz; displacement noise = n_a / (2 pi f)^2; page-sensor noise density = sigma / sqrt(rate / 2)

leverarm_open_loop.definition: RMS of (estimate - true nib acceleration) / RMS(true), both band-passed 3-15 Hz; seed 5000 (tuning), 0.3 mm tremor; rho_t = rho_w = rho

phase_and_distance.setup: rho 0.5, 8 Hz 0.3 mm, seed 5000; rotation phase psi_t relative to the hand tremor; board IMU at 78/100/120 mm
phase_and_distance.note: computed after the sensors stage with the stage's own code (fusion/run_study.py stage_sensors, same seed and settings) and merged here

friction_control.setup: tuning seeds 5000-5001, 6 and 10 Hz, 0.3 mm; frictionless = PencilConfig(mu_skid=0, mu_nib=0.02)

imu_noise_closed_loop.setup: AKF (gyro-compensated, rho 0.5) with the LSM6DSV16X (60 ug/sqrt(Hz)) or BMI323 (180 ug/sqrt(Hz)) noise; tuning seeds 5000-5001, 4/8/12 Hz, 0.3 mm

jitter_check.setup: tremor-band oracle (true disturbance 3-15 Hz, zero-phase) plus band-limited Gaussian jitter of the stated RMS, tuning seeds 5000-5001, 8 Hz 0.3 mm; the stage's first resonance is 192 Hz (config/pencil.yaml)

leverarm_closed_loop.setup: AKF tuned with the gyroscope-compensated IMU, run with each compensation; tuning seeds 5000-5001, 4/8/12 Hz, 0.3 mm

imu_aa_check.setup: internal kfosc (core mode 3), seeds 200-203, 4-12 Hz, 0.3 mm; page sensor 1 kHz / 2 ms or 120 Hz / 10 ms (sensing.opt_rate / opt_delay overrides)

meta.evidence_status: CALCULATION (datasheet values labelled MFR with ledger ids; assumptions labelled); SIMULATION (pencil model P1, synthetic handwriting and synthetic tremor; nothing measured)
